The calendar is set up on "Agenda-manifestations", using the event name as the event label, with crowd sourcing turned on. The write was accepted and the stored document reads back correctly.

- **Dataset:** `Agenda-manifestations` (`https://koumoul.com/data-fair/api/v1/datasets/hokfkn9ym3s9pr-yt1atgzl-`).
- **Event label:** `nomevenement`, the column titled "Nom de l'évenement".
- **Crowd sourcing:** enabled, so visitors can propose new events.

I did not choose a contributions dataset. The schema offers one for storing visitor proposals, and the user didn't name one, so the proposals' destination is unset. Tell me which REST dataset to use if you want one.

I also left the other calendar options at their defaults, including the colour scheme and the event detail fields.
